subject: RiverMark onboarding - PO flexibility for pilot
messages:
From: Sara Klein <sara.k@rivermark.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: onboarding@rivermark.com
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RiverMark onboarding: questions on PO requirement

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick intro this week — excited to get RiverMark connected for the 3-month pilot. I attached our standard onboarding form and W-9 (see attachments). A quick question on purchasing: does Redwood require a PO for initial pilots, or can we invoice against an SOW without a PO while the account is in trial? Our finance team prefers to avoid setting up a PO for short pilots unless required.

Can you confirm what you need from us to get billing set up?

Attachments: RiverMark_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF), RiverMark_W9.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Sara Klein
Head of Partnerships
RiverMark Technologies
---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Klein <sara.k@rivermark.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RiverMark onboarding: questions on PO requirement

Hi Sara — thanks, and great to meet you over email.

Short answer: Redwood's standard practice is to require a PO for supplier billing to ensure invoices route through AP and are matched to contracts. That said, for small pilots we sometimes approve a temporary no-PO flow if Procurement + Finance sign off, and if there's an SOW or statement of work that limits spend.

Neha / Laura — looping you both in to confirm whether we can do a controlled exception for RiverMark's 3-month pilot (expected spend ~ $12k). If approved, we will require: 1) signed SOW 2) invoice sent to ap-invoices@redwood.com with the pilot reference 3) procurement exception form completed.

Sara — can you confirm the expected pilot invoice cadence (one invoice at completion or monthly) and attach the SOW if you have it?

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 14:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RiverMark onboarding: questions on PO requirement

Marcus / Laura — reading through Marcus's note and RiverMark's ask. Procurement policy refresher: standard suppliers require a PO for any recurring or multi‑month engagements. Exceptions are considered when: total pilot spend < $20,000, there is a signed SOW identifying scope and duration, and AP has a direct invoice routing + vendor banking info.

Given RiverMark's estimate (~$12k) and scope, Procurement is prepared to approve a temporary no‑PO exception with the following controls:
- Complete procurement-exception-form.pdf (attached)
- Signed SOW on company letterhead
- Invoice(s) must reference the SOW and be sent to ap-invoices@redwood.com; payment terms net 30
- Exception expires automatically at end of pilot (no rollover)

Aditya — can Finance confirm net-30 acceptance and that AP will process invoices without a PO if the exception form is on file?

If we get those confirmations, Procurement will issue an approved-exception-notice that Marcus can forward to RiverMark.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: procurement-exception-form.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: RiverMark onboarding: questions on PO requirement

Sara — good news, Procurement and Finance have approved a limited exception for the pilot. Please proceed with the following ASAP so AP can process invoices without a PO:

1) Sign and return the SOW (attach to reply)
2) Complete and return the procurement-exception-form (attached)
3) Send invoice(s) to ap-invoices@redwood.com referencing the SOW and this exception (RM-ONB-2026-09)

Neha / Aditya — thanks for the quick turnaround. I've attached the approved-exception-notice for RiverMark's file.

Sara — once we have the SOW and completed form I'll confirm the exception in writing (formal approved-exception-notice attached). If anything changes (scope or expected spend), Procurement will reassess.

Best regards,
Marcus Lin
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
